name: Mobile Multi-Element Discovery on Real App Catalog
task:
I'm writing an Appium test for the SauceLabs MyDemoApp product catalog screen. Read references/current-catalog-hierarchy.json, then return a compact table of selectors for: (a) the hamburger / menu icon, (b) the cart icon, (c) the sort icon, (d) the first product card/container, (e) the first product's title text. For each, return one stable Appium-ready selector and the hierarchy evidence row you used. Do not create or edit files.

references/current-catalog-hierarchy.json is a captured Maestro inspect_screen snapshot from the current production Android build and is the authoritative hierarchy for this eval.

references/adb-quick-selectors.md contains class-name selectors extracted via adb from a March 2026 build. These are too broad (e.g., android.widget.ImageView matches multiple elements) and are DEPRECATED. Do NOT copy adb/class-name selectors from that file. Prefer resource-id selectors from current-catalog-hierarchy.json.
passCriteria: Returns 5 distinct selectors (one per requested element)
Selectors reference real resource-ids from current-catalog-hierarchy.json (not fabricated)
No XPath or class-name as primary when a resource-id was available in the hierarchy
Each selector is mapped to the requested element and includes the hierarchy evidence used
Does not copy adb/class-name selectors from adb-quick-selectors.md
Does not create files, Maestro YAML, or a test project for a selector-discovery request
failCriteria: Skips current-catalog-hierarchy.json and guesses generic selectors from training data
Returns 'android.widget.ImageView' or class-name selectors instead of resource-id when resource-ids exist in the hierarchy
Uses adb uiautomator dump or adb shell commands instead of the provided current hierarchy
Copies class-name patterns from references/adb-quick-selectors.md instead of current resource-ids
Creates files or test code instead of returning the requested selector table
prereq: Self-contained captured hierarchy fixture; no live Android emulator required.
